channel.description: Latest stable releases and updates for OnCue.

item.title: OnCue 1.0.0
item.description:
OnCue 1.0.0 Release Notes

  • Native macOS architecture built with Swift, SwiftUI and Apple AVKit
  • IPTV Live Stream, Movies and Series playback
  • Interactive EPG TV Guide and fast channel switching
  • Multi-View (Dual & Quad Screen) simultaneous player
  • Encrypted hardware credential storage via Apple Keychain
  • Full English & Turkish localization support
  • Universal 2: Native on Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4) & Intel Macs
